description:
The single signed governance receipt: `runx.receipt.v1`.

`decisions[]` (each choice and the act it selects) and `acts[]` (intent, the caller's reason, the checks bound to each act) are inline. Every field is signed; display identity comes from `subject.kind`, `subject.ref`, `issuer` and `authority.actor_ref`.

items.description: What was done, inline. The act's semantic core (intent, the caller's reason, the checks bound to it) stays in the signed body; its outcome is the receipt's seal. Only the bulky execution I/O (the agent-context envelope: instructions/inputs/output and tool calls) is referenced via `context_ref` and hydrated by projections.
